notes: AI Answer Benchmark 2.0 — permanent edge cases added by AI Brain 2 (docs/AI_BRAIN_2_AUDIT.md). The original 123 questions in questions.json are untouched; run both with `--suite all`.

Every label was verified against the live corpus on 2026-09-11 (read-only): ISBNs and titles are real `books` rows; topic sources are the books with the most `book_pages` rows containing the phrase; `no_answer` subjects were confirmed to appear on zero pages.
`sources` is a recall list, never exhaustive — a question may be answered well from an unlabelled book that also discusses the topic.
